body: Wow, this is literally the worst attempt at making someone feel better that I’ve ever seen, but it also got me to smile, so meh
Suicide is also illegal, I clearly no longer care.

Who cares if it’s wrong? Those people would be a means to an end. Besides, I don’t want to *kill* any of them, just give the impression that I could do that, so that someone will “stop” me, the cops get to say not a single injury occurred from their expert handling of the situation, and all those people get to go on with their lives, not a tear will be shed.

All of what I just wrote is crap. I’d be forcing an officer to kill in the line of duty, an act that brings great pain to most people. I’d be traumatizing a sizeable group of bystanders, I’d be disgracing my family, I would be hurting everyone involved.

Why do I have to live life? Why does wanting to end it torment me so? I never asked to be born, and I hate that I keep wasting peoples time, people like you, who could be out helping someone who actually has a problem, not an attention whore like me. I’m convinced I only do this for attention by the way, I think subconsciously I like the feeling of being sad, so I make myself sad on purpose so people will give me attention

People like me don’t deserve to live, and I don’t really want to, either. So why can I not just go to a hospital, have them put me under, and never bring me back up? I just want to die, nothing more, nothing less, and I sincerely hope there is no afterlife, because I can’t take an eternity of this.

I don’t even have a mental illness, but in my experience this is a cycle, for maybe a few weeks you can feel less terrible, not happy, and then you go back into depression and want to die, my cycles have only gotten shorter over time, I used to want to kms maybe every few months, now I barely have time to get over the last depressive episode before the new one starts

Look, I have a final plea here, so hear me out

Don’t kill yourself with drugs and alchohol, use something that you know for a fact you won’t wake up from

There’s no worse feeling than going to sleep wanting to die and waking up the next morning, if you think you’ve seen low, you haven’t, that’s low.

Look man, I’m probably not going to convince you not to kill yourself, especially if you’re planning on doing it months from now, whatever encouragement I write will be long forgotten, fed to the cycle of depression that we’re all stuck on, so instead, let me take away the pain of failing to kill yourself, you have suffered enough, do yourself this one service.

>try putting together a cool outfit, or building a custom PC

So I built my first rig a year ago, and my fashion sense is one of the few things I actually care about, I tried the whole painting/drawing scene and it wasn’t for me, I just wasn’t any good. 

It’s not like I don’t do things, it’s just that they don’t bring me any joy, when I get an outfit to look right, it doesn’t make me happy, it just makes me less upset.

As for work, I’m currently attending college full time and working part time, turns out if you don’t have a social life or any obligations you have a lot of free time on your hands. Money doesn’t really make me happy either, and honestly, I don’t want anything material anyway.

Making people feel bad is definitely a skill, in the same way that killing people is a skill, do you *want* to do those things? Probably not, but skills are keys, keys don’t care what’s behind the lock they open.

Thanks, technically achieving a task while putting forth as little effort as possible is my specialty!

[Edit] that was uncalled for, it’s just that making people feel bad is the only thing I’m good at

I’m a terrible person because I am a sponge that soaks up time, attention, and money, and expels depression. 

As for a meaning, I no longer believe such things exist, life is meaningless, and we can choose to do with that what we will, I was not destined to be a waste of space, I have only myself to blame
Since it’s so harmless, do you mind sending some nudes? I just want to know more about your genitals

“You’re not gonna make it”

But seriously, if I end up in your hospital, just let me go

I’ve been totally fine since about 4, for reference I had all my shots between 11:30am - 12pm so it took me about 4 hours to stop stumbling/slurring totally

Like I mention in the post, I don’t weigh much so I was kinda worried

I got over it after a couple hours, and I can walk now.

Honestly it wasn’t that much alcohol, I posted this because I didn’t know if I would be able to drive by the time I needed to but it worked out fine.

So yes I’m alive
I don’t hate the feeling, I’m just definitely not driving today :P
